own_solution.law: Z0 = sqrt(Ltot/Ctot) = 50 Ω. The incident voltage is Vs Z0/(Rs + Z0), and the load reflection coefficient is (RL − Z0)/(RL + Z0) = 0.5. Thus the initial load voltage is 10 V. With an added series resistance q, VL = 750/(75 + q) V when q is expressed in ohms.
assumptions: The uniform lossless cable follows the ideal transmission-line model.
The source applies a voltage step to the initially uncharged cable carrying no current.
The observation precedes the return of a source-reflected wave.
The independently powered lamp has no electrical connection to the transmission-line circuit.
